{{Quote|There were bound to be ''repercussions.'' Rallo knew that. The Empire wouldn't let such an open act of insurgence go unpunished. A message had to be delivered. Maybe a full-scale invasion of the settlement&hellip;maybe something ''worse.'' He couldn't possibly have ''imagined.''<nowiki></nowiki>|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="Lucky" />}}
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] conducted a '''bombing''' of the [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Gus Talon/Legends|Gus Talon]] early during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in retaliation against a local [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel cell (Gus Talon)|cell]]. The [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Rallo]] secretly ran the cell from his [[Rallo's workshop|workshop]] in a small [[Gus Talon settlement|settlement]] on Gus Talon along with his [[Gender/Legends|daughter]], [[Mala Tinero]]. When an Imperial occupation force led by one [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Turrant]] discovered the cell's existence [[2 BBY/Legends|two years before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and tried to shut it down, Rallo and his men fought back, [[Death/Legends|killing]] five [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in a [[Lightfight|shootout]] inside the workshop.

The Empire responded by unleashing fourteen [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]] upon the small settlement in a devastating bombardment that killed many Gus Talon citizens, including Rallo and his daughter. Stormtroopers entered the destroyed settlement afterward and took away most of the survivors aboard [[Prison ship/Legends|prison ships]]. Tinero's boyfriend, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], who had resisted joining the Rebellion up to that point, had by a stroke of luck been away from Gus Talon during the incident or would have been a casualty himself, but his grief over losing Tinero finally motivated him to join the fight against the Empire.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|When are you and your troops leaving?''"<br />"''Oh, maybe in a few weeks, maybe never. Maybe a ''permanent'' presence here is what you people really need&hellip;some good, healthy ''discipline.'' These are ''dangerous'' times. We've picked up intel on a ''Rebel cell'' operating near here. Now&hellip;you wouldn't happen to ''know'' anything about that&hellip;''would'' you, Rallo?''"<br />"''I'm a mechanic. Nothing more.''"<br />"''Of course.|Rallo and Captain Turrant|<ref name="Lucky" />}}
[[File:TurrantSuspectsRallo-SWTales23.png|thumb|left|215px|Captain Turrant suspected Rallo's involvement in the Gus Talon Rebel cell.]]
In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a provisional [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] occupation of [[Gus Talon/Legends|Gus Talon]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of<ref name="Lucky" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The occupation force included a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] detachment assigned to a small but bustling [[Gus Talon settlement|settlement]] with a majority-[[Human/Legends|Human]], mixed-[[Species/Legends|species]] population that also comprised [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]] and [[Drall (planet)|Drall]]. Responsibility for overseeing the detachment fell to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Turrant]], a harsh, middle-aged [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] who developed a tense acquaintance with local resident [[Rallo]], a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] who lived and worked on Gus Talon with his [[Gender/Legends|daughter]], [[Mala Tinero]].<ref name="Lucky" />

Rallo secretly ran a local [[Rebel cell (Gus Talon)|cell]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] out of his [[Rallo's workshop|workshop]] in the Gus Talon [[City/Legends|settlement]], ostensibly employing several other individuals, including Tinero. The girl tried to get her boyfriend, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], also of Gus Talon, to join the Rebellion as well, but the young man could not be convinced. Meanwhile, [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|intelligence]] of the Rebel cell's existence soon came to Turrant's attention. During a chance run-in with Rallo and Antilles on the settlement's streets, Turrant took the opportunity to insinuate his suspicions of the mechanic's involvement with the Rebel cell, but Rallo calmly maintained his innocence.<ref name="Lucky" />

==The bombing==
{{Quote|Rallo!''"<br />"''What do you want, Turrant? I'm working!''"<br />"''Not any more. I am ''confiscating'' this workshop, and everything in it, in the name of the ''Empire.''<nowiki></nowiki>''"<br />"''You're joking.''"<br />"''No, I am not. These premises will be torn apart and searched. You are under arrest, as are your employees.|Captain Turrant and his stormtroopers confront Rallo|<ref name="Lucky" />}}
[[File:RalloProtectsMala-SWTales23.png|thumb|right|250px|Rallo opens fire on Captain Turrant's stormtroopers, inciting a battle that culminated in the Imperial bombing of Gus Talon.]]
Shortly after their encounter on the streets, Turrant and a group of five stormtroopers confronted Rallo and his men at the mechanic's workshop, interrupting their labor in the middle of the [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. Turrant announced that he had come to seize the workshop and everything inside it in the name of the Empire, and that Rallo and all of his employees, including his daughter, were under arrest for their involvement with the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Lucky" />

When Turrant suggested that he would send Tinero to be incarcerated off-world, away from her [[Parent/Legends|father's]] protection, Rallo immediately opened fire on the stormtroopers with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. A [[lightfight]] erupted inside the workshop between Turrant's [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and the members of Rallo's Rebel cell, who instantly produced [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] of their own and proceeded to kill all five stormtroopers&mdash;a heroic stand against an oppressive occupying force, it was said. However, Turrant himself escaped the battle and quickly called for reinforcements via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="Lucky" />

The Empire struck back by sending in fourteen [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] on an attack run, which razed the Gus Talon settlement, leaving it in crumbling ruins.<ref name="Lucky" /> Rallo and his daughter were among<ref name="CSWE" /> the many citizens of Gus Talon [[Death/Legends|killed]] in<ref name="Lucky" /> the senseless bombardment.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|By order of the Emperor, Gus Talon is now under Imperial rule. Any attempt to enter the system will be met ''with deadly force.''<nowiki></nowiki>''"<br />"''What?''"<br />"''Repeat. Turn back now or you will be ''destroyed.''<nowiki></nowiki>''"<br />"''But&hellip;I ''live'' there! You ''can't&hellip;''<nowiki></nowiki>''"<br />"''All citizens of Gus Talon are now ''prisoners'' of the Empire.|Wedge Antilles encounters the Imperial blockade above Gus Talon while trying to return home|<ref name="Lucky" />}}
[[File:GusTalonRuins-SWTales23.png|thumb|left|250px|Wedge Antilles surveys the destruction of the Gus Talon settlement.]]
After the bombing, stormtroopers entered the destroyed Gus Talon settlement and carried away most of the survivors on [[Prison ship/Legends|prison ships]], although no one who remained knew where they had been taken. The Empire placed Gus Talon under official Imperial rule, declared all of its citizens to be Imperial [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], and stationed an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the moon to lock down the system.<ref name="Lucky" />

Wedge Antilles had been away from Gus Talon during the Imperial bombing of the settlement, having taken a brief job transporting machine parts off-system, but he would have taken part in the battle between Rallo's men and Turrant's stormtroopers had he been there. When he returned to Gus Talon aboard his small [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], he encountered the Imperial blockade above the moon, which forcibly rebuffed his request to land. Antilles protested that he lived on Gus Talon, which only prompted two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] to [[Starfighter combat/Legends|engage]] his [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. Outraged at the sudden loss of Tinero, Antilles shot down one of the two [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]], but he was forced to flee the system when the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] sent more TIEs after him.<ref name="Lucky" />

With little left on Gus Talon worth guarding, the Imperial forces pulled out eight days after Antilles' initial attempt to land on the moon. He was finally able to get back into his home on the ninth day, when he saw for himself the devastation that the Imperial bombardment had wrought on the settlement. None of the survivors could tell him what had happened to Tinero, and he realized that he would have been killed or imprisoned too had he been there. Grieving deeply over losing Tinero,<ref name="Lucky" /> Antilles joined the Rebel Alliance soon after<ref name="CSWE" /> and would go on to become its greatest starfighter [[Ace/Legends|ace]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|wedgeantilles|Antilles, Wedge}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The bombing of Gus Talon was featured in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] "[[Lucky (comic story)|Lucky]]," which was included in [[Star Wars Tales 23|issue 23]] of the ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'' comic series. "Lucky" was written by [[Rob Williams]] and illustrated by [[Michel Lacombe]], while ''Star Wars Tales'' 23 was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Lucky" /> on [[May 11]], [[2005]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54696/star_wars_tales_1999_23|text=Star Wars Tales (1999) #23}}</ref> The bombing serves as the tragic inspiration for Wedge Antilles joining the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Lucky" />
